lines.en: label halloweentwo2:
scene halloweentwobar1
I arrive at the bar with Sana to find the place already decked out in...well, not decorations, but whatever weird light bulbs Sara normally uses to make the color in here all pink and whatnot.
lines.zh: 我和Sana到了酒吧，发现店里已经挂满了……嗯，算不上装饰，就是Sara平时用来把这儿弄得粉粉的那种奇怪灯泡。

lines.en: Apart from the lights, however, it doesn’t really appear that things have gotten underway as of yet.
lines.zh: 不过除了灯光，看起来一切还没真正开始。

lines.en: I mean, there are no guests around- not even Maki and Haruka. And given that this place has been doing a little better than normal lately, that’s kind of disappointing.
lines.zh: 我是说，一个客人都没有——连Maki和Haruka都不在。考虑到这地方最近生意比平时好一点，这还挺让人失望的。

lines.en: I’m not really sure why I’m thinking so much about it, though, when I clearly have more important things to be doing.
lines.zh: 不过我也不明白自己为什么要想这么多，明明我有更要紧的事要做。

lines.en: Like helping Sana get dressed.
lines.zh: 比如帮Sana换衣服。

lines.en: : Do you require assistance?
lines.zh: : 需要我帮忙吗？

lines.en: : ...I’m sorry?
: Picking out clothes.
lines.zh: : 挑衣服。

lines.en: : Or putting them on, I guess.
lines.zh: : 或者帮你穿上，也行。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不用。

lines.en: : No, I think I’m okay...
lines.zh: : 不用，我觉得我自己可以……

lines.en: Fuck Halloween.
lines.zh: 去他妈的万圣节。

lines.en: : Everything I’m supposed to bring to the party is...pretty light...so you can just stay down here and wait for me to get back...
lines.zh: : 我要带去派对的东西……都挺轻的……所以你可以在楼下等着，等我回来……

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t need me to come up there and help with anything?
lines.zh: : 你确定不需要我上楼去帮什么忙？

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar2
: Uh...well...
: I kind of...yelled at you the last time we were up there together, so...
lines.zh: : 上次我们一起上去的时候，我有点……冲你吼了，所以……

lines.en: : I think it’s probably best if you just stay down here...
lines.zh: : 我觉得你还是待在楼下比较好……

lines.en: : Yes. I can see how having me {i}closer{/i} to your mother is better at quelling your uncertainty about our relationship than having me in her room with you.
lines.zh: : 行。我明白了，比起让我跟你一起待在你妈的房间里，让我离你妈{i}更近{/i}，反而更能打消你对我们关系的不安。

lines.en: : Well...it sounds weird when you put it like that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……被你这么一说，听着好奇怪……

lines.en: : Because it is weird. But if that’s what you want, it’s fine by me.
lines.zh: : 因为它本来就奇怪。不过既然你这么想，我没意见。

lines.en: : Could be good to catch up with her anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正跟她叙叙旧也不错。

lines.en: : Just...don’t catch up too much...hahah...
lines.zh: : 只是……别叙得太过头了……哈哈……

lines.en: : Hah...
scene halloweentwobar3
Well...that’s that, I guess.
lines.zh: 嗯……就这么着吧，我想。

lines.en: scene black
scene halloweentwobar5
: Well, if it isn’t my favorite customer!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这不是我最喜欢的客人嘛！

lines.en: : Hey, Sara. You’re looking mostly sober tonight.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sara。你今晚看起来大体上是清醒的。

lines.en: : You too, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 你也是，Yuki。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar6
: Hey! How come your voice sounded a lot more gentle when you said that to her?
lines.zh: : 嘿！你跟她说这话的时候，声音为什么温柔那么多？

lines.en: : Probably because Yuki’s sobriety is something we should be praising and yours is something we should be encouraging.
lines.zh: : 大概因为Yuki的清醒是值得表扬的，而你的清醒是需要鼓励的。

lines.en: : Thanks, man. Sara’s not that far gone yet, though. ‘Least not from what I’ve seen.
lines.zh: : 谢了，老兄。不过Sara也没烂醉到那个地步。至少我看到的没有。

lines.en: : I’ll have you know I’ve been doing {i}much{/i} better lately when it comes to not drinking while the bar is open.
lines.zh: : 我可得告诉你，最近我在“营业时间不喝酒”这件事上已经进步{i}很多{/i}了。

lines.en: : I wait until the doors are closed now.
lines.zh: : 我现在会等到打烊之后再喝。

lines.en: : Well, that’s a step in the right direction, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那也算朝着正确的方向迈了一步吧。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar7
: So, are you going to stay for the Halloween party again this year? Maki and Haruka are on their way over now.
lines.zh: : 那么，今年万圣节派对你还留下来吗？Maki和Haruka正在过来的路上。

lines.en: : And, if the rumors I’ve heard are true, their costumes are even more...risque this year.
lines.zh: : 而且，如果我听到的传闻属实，她们今年的变装服还要更……暴露。

lines.en: : Speaking of which, where’s yours? You seem like the type to pretty much always dress up for stuff like this.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你的呢？你看起来是那种逢这种场合必打扮的人。

lines.en: : Not tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚不。

lines.en: : Well...at least not until I know how business is going to be.
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少在摸清生意状况之前不。

lines.en: : I’m sure we won’t be like, {i}actually{/i} busy or anything, but I still have Yuki and your friend from the last party coming to temp for the night while Sana is out being a [teenager].
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定我们不会{i}真的{/i}忙起来什么的，不过Sana出去当[teenager]的时候，我还有Yuki和你上次派对认识的那位朋友来顶一晚上。

lines.en: : Basically, I am prepared to work if I have to. And since my feminine wiles don’t work as well on our female clientele, I don’t {i}have{/i} to get dressed up. I just want to.
lines.zh: : 总之，要干活我也准备好了。而且既然我的女性魅力对女客不太管用，我也{i}不必{/i}盛装打扮。我只是想打扮而已。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar8
: Besides, Yuki’s popular enough with the girls to make it so I barely even have to do anything.
lines.zh: : 再说了，Yuki在女孩子里够受欢迎了，我都几乎不用做什么。

lines.en: : Yuki is? Really?
lines.zh: : Yuki受欢迎？真的吗？

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar9
: Yo. The fuck is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 喂。你那话什么意思？

lines.en: : Hey, don’t ask me. You’re the one always calling yourself “not cute” or whatever.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别问我。不是你老说自己“不可爱”什么的吗。

lines.en: : Not my fault that a bunch of girls are just settlin’ for the closest thing to a dude they can get with all the real ones up in space or whatever the fuck is goin’ on.
lines.zh: : 一群女生退而求其次，找个最像男人的将就一下，这又不是我的错——毕竟真正的男人都跑到太空上去了还是怎么的。

lines.en: : I’d be willing to bet cash that any girl with short hair’s gettin’ the same fuckin’ treatment I am.
lines.zh: : 我敢拿现金打赌，任何短头发的女生都跟我享受一样的待遇。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar10
: Oh, stop. That uniform looks absolutely adorable on you. It’s no wonder so many girls are flocking to the place now.
lines.zh: : 哦，行了。那套制服穿在你身上可爱极了。难怪现在这么多女生往这儿跑。

lines.en: : Yeah, sure the fuckin’ fliers you’ve been handin’ out to everyone and their mothers have nothin’ to do with it.
lines.zh: : 是、是啊，你发给所有人还有他们妈的那些传单肯定一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : Fliers mean nothing in the face of true beauty, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 在真正的美貌面前，传单一文不值，Yuki。

lines.en: : Guh.
: Good. Now, kiss.
lines.zh: : 好。现在，亲一个。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar11
: I suppose one wouldn’t hurt if that’s what you want to see, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 如果你想看的话，来一个也无妨，Sensei。

lines.en: : The fuck, dude?! No! Not only is she a chick, she’s my boss now!
lines.zh: : 你他妈说什么？！不行！她不但是个女的，现在还是我老板！

lines.en: : ‘Sides, what if people fuckin’ walk in or whatever? Can’t say I’d wanna spend my money at some place where the employees are fucking behind the counters.
lines.zh: : 再说了，万一有人他妈的走进来什么的怎么办？我可不想花钱去一家员工在吧台后面乱搞的地方。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar12
: I mean...I don’t think Sensei said anything about {i}fucking...{/i}but I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t at least a little curious...
lines.zh: : 我是说……Sensei好像也没说要{i}乱搞{/i}什么的……但要说我一点都不好奇，那我是在撒谎……

lines.en: : Oh, you’ve gotta be fucking kidding me. You too?
lines.zh: : 哦，你他妈在逗我吧。你也是？

lines.en: : You’re just really popular now, Yuki. Embrace it.
lines.zh: : 你现在真的很受欢迎啊，Yuki。接受吧。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar13
: Hah...whatever. ‘Least I’m gettin’ paid.
lines.zh: : 哈……随便吧。至少我还有工资拿。

lines.en: : I’m still waiting on an answer to whether or not you’re staying, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我还在等你的回答呢，Sensei，你到底留不留下来。

lines.en: : I’m sure someone like you would be preeeetty popular around a bunch of sexually dissatisfied women.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，像你这样的人在一群性欲得不到满足的女人中间会非常非常受欢迎。

lines.en: : Assuming they show up, that is.
lines.zh: : 前提是她们真的来。

lines.en: : As fond as I am of sexually dissatisfied women, I’m not sure if I’m able to hang around this time.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很喜欢性欲得不到满足的女人，但这次我恐怕没法多待。

lines.en: : Pretty sure the party for my class is basically underway already.
lines.zh: : 我们班的派对应该已经差不多开始了。

lines.en: Not to mention I’d much prefer being in a room full of primarily virgins than one with a handful of women who have been around the block a few times.
lines.zh: 更别提比起和一屋子阅人无数的女人待在一起，我更愿意待在一屋子大部分是处女的房间里。

lines.en: Sue me.
lines.zh: 要告就告我吧。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar14
: Are you really gonna say no to these cute little faces?
lines.zh: : 你真的要对这些可爱的小脸蛋说不吗？

lines.en: : We need you, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 我们需要你呀，Sensei~

lines.en: : We need you to save our bar...{i}and our bodies...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们需要你来拯救我们的酒吧……{i}还有我们的身体{/i}……

lines.en: : I think I’m good, actually. Not in the best shape anymore, but don’t think I need {i}saving{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我还好，真的。身材是不如从前了，但还不至于需要人{i}救{/i}。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar15
: Really? Because I’d think that if {i}anyone{/i} in this room needed saving, it would be you.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我还以为这屋里要说{i}谁{/i}需要被拯救，那一定是你呢。

lines.en: : Dude, there are three people in this room. And you two are making it pretty clear you fuck like rabbits already, so...
lines.zh: : 老兄，这屋里就三个人。而且你们两个摆明了已经像兔子一样乱搞了，所以……

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
scene halloweentwobar16
: Weeeeeell...I don’t know if {i}rabbits{/i} is the right word...
lines.zh: : 唔……嗯……我不知道“{i}兔子{/i}”这个词合不合适……

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Sure, boss.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。当然了，老板。

lines.en: : Now, can you let go of my chin? You’re startin’ to leave a mark.
lines.zh: : 那，你能松开我的下巴了吗？你都开始留下印子了。

lines.en: else:
scene halloweentwobar17
: Oh...no.
lines.zh: : 哦……不是的。

lines.en: : Sensei and I are just friends, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实我和Sensei只是朋友。

lines.en: : I just get a little flirty around him sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我只是在他身边偶尔会有点轻浮。

lines.en: : Really? Well, sure had me fooled.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那我可真是被骗惨了。

lines.en: scene black
Sara goes silent for a moment before finally removing her finger from Yuki’s chin.
lines.zh: Sara沉默了片刻，终于把手指从Yuki的下巴上挪开。

lines.en: Before the conversation is able to pick back up, however, the “friend of mine” that Sara alluded to earlier finally decides to walk in...
lines.zh: 不过在这段对话继续下去之前，Sara先前暗示的那位“我的朋友”终于走进了门……

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar18
: Hello, attractive bartender woman!
lines.zh: : 你好，迷人的女酒保！

lines.en: : I have returned to this building of female fornication for the purpose of pouring liquids into hollow glass cylinders and making people dizzy!
lines.zh: : 我回到了这座女性交媾之建筑，目的是把液体倒进空心的玻璃圆柱里，把人弄得晕头转向！

lines.en: : Please pay me in feathers!
lines.zh: : 请用羽毛支付我！

lines.en: : Wha-
: Welcome back, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来，Kaori。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar19
: Ah! Friend! You are here as well!
lines.zh: : 啊！朋友！你也在这里！

lines.en: : Do you intend to fornicate with the bar lady or her handsome friend with sadbags under her eyes?
lines.zh: : 你打算和这位酒吧女士交媾，还是和她那位眼袋很重的英俊朋友？

lines.en: : Please warn me beforehand if you do so I can look away and pretend to not hear anything!
lines.zh: : 如果要的话请事先警告我，好让我转过头去，假装什么都没听见！

lines.en: scene black
Kaori makes her way over to the bar and Yuki looks incredibly dumbfounded for some-
lines.zh: Kaori走到吧台前，Yuki看起来一脸茫然，因为某——

lines.en: Oh. Wait.
lines.zh: 哦。等等。

lines.en: Yeah, this is probably really weird for her considering the last conversation I had {i}about{/i} Kaori ended with me finding out she's related to Yumi.
lines.zh: 是啊，这对她来说大概真的很怪，毕竟我上次{i}聊到{/i}Kaori的那次对话，是以我发现她和Yumi有血缘关系收尾的。

lines.en: And...if Kaori is related to Yumi, it’s probably safe to assume...yeah.
lines.zh: 而且……如果Kaori和Yumi有关系，那大概可以安全地推测……嗯。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar20
: Surprise.
lines.zh: : 惊喜吧。

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Yuki?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Yuki？

lines.en: : Bar lady, have you created a new policy in which customers order beverages from the opposite side of the large wooden rectangle?
lines.zh: : 酒吧女士，你是新规定了客人要从大木矩形的另一侧点饮料吗？

lines.en: : No, Kaori. Yuki is an employee here.
lines.zh: : 不是，Kaori。Yuki是这里的员工。

lines.en: : I think it may be time to fire her, for she does not appear to be doing much of anything.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是时候解雇她了，因为她看起来什么都没做。

lines.en: : Allow me to step in here and try to explain the situation just enough to not cause anyone’s brain to malfunction.
lines.zh: : 让我插一句，试着把情况解释到刚好不让任何人的大脑死机的程度。

lines.en: : Well, any more than it already malfunctions on a daily basis.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少别比它日常死机的程度更严重。

lines.en: : Yuki actually knows Kaori.
lines.zh: : Yuki其实认识Kaori。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar21
: Is this about the instant gram again?! I already took those pictures down! This should have erased the memory of everyone who saw them!
lines.zh: : 又是为了 instant gram 的事吗？！我已经把那些照片删掉了！这应该能抹掉所有看过的人的记忆了吧！

lines.en: : That’s not how memory or...any of that works, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 记忆不是这么运作的，Kaori。……这些东西哪一样都不是。

lines.en: : What do you mean Yuki knows her? From where?
lines.zh: : 你说Yuki认识她是什么意思？在哪儿认识的？

lines.en: : Well...
: We’re related...
lines.zh: : 我们是有血缘的……

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar22
: You’re what?! Really?
lines.zh: : 你们什么？！真的假的？

lines.en: : She’s my niece.
lines.zh: : 她是我外甥女。

lines.en: : I believe the word is pronounced “nice.” And thank you, tired-looking woman.
lines.zh: : 我认为那个词应该念成“乖”。谢谢夸奖，看起来疲惫不堪的女士。

lines.en: : Kaori, a niece is a sibling’s child. Like the red haired girl you’ve seen me with before.
lines.zh: : Kaori，外甥女是兄弟姐妹的孩子。就像你之前见过的那个红头发女孩跟我的关系。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar23
: But, Friend! I have seen you with so many girls that it is impossible to keep track of them all!
lines.zh: : 可是，朋友！我见过你和太多女孩在一起了，根本数不过来！

lines.en: : Besides, the hospital people told me everyone else was gone. I do not have what you humans would call a “family.”
lines.zh: : 再说了，医院的人告诉我其他人都没了。我没有你们人类所谓的“家人”。

lines.en: : You really don’t remember me? I used to pick you up and take you to hang out with Yumi when she was still all little and shit.
lines.zh: : 你真不记得我了？以前都是我去接你，带你去跟Yumi玩，那会儿她还小不点儿呢。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar24
: My memory became bad after the whapam, kaboom, shhhhhhhh. I don’t remember you at all.
lines.zh: : 在 whapam、kaboom、shhhhhhhh 之后，我的记忆就变差了。我完全不记得你。

lines.en: : Wow. Small fuckin' world.
lines.zh: : 哇。这世界真他妈小。

lines.en: : I do not see what the size of the world has to do with our relation, but “Earth” is actually very large. Bigger than three whole cheese wheels.
lines.zh: : 我不明白世界的大小和我们的亲缘关系有什么关系，不过“地球”确实很大。比整整三个奶酪轮还大。

lines.en: : How long have you known about this?
lines.zh: : 你知道这事多久了？

lines.en: : Not long. I just found out recently and...I guess it slipped my mind until right now?
lines.zh: : 不久。我也是最近才知道，然后……大概直到刚才才想起来？

lines.en: : Umm...Mom?...
scene halloweentwobar25
: Sana, dear. What in the world are you supposed to be?
lines.zh: : Sana，亲爱的。你这身到底扮的是什么？

lines.en: : I don’t even know anymore...
lines.zh: : 我自己都不知道了……

lines.en: : That is certainly an...interesting choice for a costume.
lines.zh: : 这确实是套……挺有意思的变装服。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar26
: I thought there would be less...revealing choices available...
lines.zh: : 我以为会有些不那么……暴露的选择……

lines.en: : I mean...it wasn’t really weird to wear more revealing clothing back then, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说……那时候穿得暴露点也不算奇怪吧？

lines.en: : We grew up around the same time, didn’t we? Back me up on this.
lines.zh: : 我们差不多是同一代长大的，不是吗？你帮我说话啊。

lines.en: : Fishnets and tight jeans I can understand. It’s the gas mask, weird gloves, and crop top with the word “Fire” on it that I’m confused by.
lines.zh: : 渔网袜和紧身牛仔裤我能理解。让我困惑的是防毒面具、奇怪的手套，还有那件印着“Fire”的露脐上衣。

lines.en: : I’m sure they...made sense at the time?
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定它们……在当时是有意义的？

lines.en: : And you’re {i}not{/i} just into really weird shit?
lines.zh: : 而你并{i}不是{/i}单纯喜欢很奇怪的东西？

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar27
: Will you like me more if I am?
lines.zh: : 如果我是的话，你会更喜欢我吗？

lines.en: : Mom! Stop!
lines.zh: : 妈妈！别说了！

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar28
: Sorry, sorry. I couldn’t help it, dear.
lines.zh: : 抱歉抱歉。我忍不住嘛，亲爱的。

lines.en: : You look adorable as...whatever you are.
lines.zh: : 你扮成……不管你扮的是什么，都很可爱。

lines.en: : Did you find all the decorations you needed?
lines.zh: : 要带的东西都找到了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, they’re near the door...Which means I’m ready to go whenever...
lines.zh: : 嗯，都在门边……也就是说我随时可以走了……

lines.en: : We’re going to have to take the bus, too, so...we should probably start heading out as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 我们还得坐公交，所以……大概得尽快出发了。

lines.en: : You guys should have just had the party here. That’s what we did for the dorm war and only a handful of you wound up getting intoxicated.
lines.zh: : 你们干脆在这儿办派对多好。宿舍大战那次就是这么干的，结果只有几个人喝醉了。

lines.en: : I will...relay that information to Ayane for next year’s party...
lines.zh: : 我会……把这条信息转达给Ayane，留到明年的派对……

lines.en: : Be safe, okay? If you’re going to drink, make sure Sensei is around to carry you to bed.
lines.zh: : 注意安全，知道吗？要是你要喝酒，记得让Sensei在你身边，好把你抱上床。

lines.en: : Sensei...please ignore her and just...come with me...
lines.zh: : Sensei……请无视她，直接……跟我走吧……

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar29
: Well, sorry I can’t stay, but...yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉我不能多待，不过……是啊。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I have a feeling we’ll be pretty busy tonight anyway, so having you around would just be a distraction for me.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我有预感今晚我们会挺忙的，所以你在这儿只会让我分心。

lines.en: : We can have our own party some other time.
lines.zh: : 我们改天再办自己的派对。

lines.en: : Have fun and look after Sana for me.
lines.zh: : 玩得开心，替我照顾好Sana。

lines.en: : Mom...come on...
lines.zh: : 妈妈……别这样……

lines.en: scene black
I follow Sana away from the bar and-
lines.zh: 我跟着Sana离开酒吧，然后——

lines.en: : Yo! Hold up a second.
lines.zh: : 喂！等一下。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar30
: What’s up? Mad at me for not confirming Kaori’s return as a zombie?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？生我的气了，因为我没提前确认Kaori会以僵尸形态回归？

lines.en: : Nah. That’s...weird as fuck, but...I’ve got the whole night to talk to her about it.
lines.zh: : 才不是。那事……怪得要死，不过……我有一整晚的时间跟她聊。

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : Well, today’s Yumi’s birthday and shit.
lines.zh: : 嗯，今天是Yumi的生日来着。

lines.en: : And I know it’s not really your place to get involved any more than you already have, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道这本来不该你多管，你已经管得够多了，不过……

lines.en: : You want me to say happy birthday for you?
lines.zh: : 你想让我替你说声生日快乐？

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar31
: Uh...yeah...
: If it’s not a problem, I mean.
lines.zh: : 如果不麻烦的话。

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar32
: If you could maybe give her this, too...
lines.zh: : 如果你能顺便把这个也给她……

lines.en: : It’s not much, but...I don’t really have a lot I can spend and-
lines.zh: : 不多，不过……我手头能花的钱也不多，而且——

lines.en: : Sure thing.
lines.zh: : 没问题。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if she’ll accept it, but I’ll definitely give it to her if she shows up to the party tonight.
lines.zh: : 我不确定她会不会收，但如果她今晚来派对，我一定会交给她。

lines.en: : Thanks, man. Remind me to buy you ramen sometime when the power’s not getting all fucked at Tojo's anymore.
lines.zh: : 谢了，老兄。等东条家的电不再他妈的乱跳了，提醒我请你吃拉面。

lines.en: : Did it happen again after the last time?
lines.zh: : 上次之后又发生了？

lines.en: : Just once more that I’ve noticed since then, but Tsu-chan still wouldn’t let me go near her dad.
lines.zh: : 从那以后我就注意到过一次，不过常酱还是不让我靠近她爸。

lines.en: : Huh. Weird.
lines.zh: : 哈。真怪。

lines.en: : Sensei? We...really need to go...
lines.zh: : Sensei？我们……真的得走了……

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar33
: Oh, shit. My bad. I was-
lines.zh: : 哦，操。我的错。我刚才——

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar34
: The fuck are you supposed to be?
lines.zh: : 你他妈扮的是什么？

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar35
: Bad at Halloween...
lines.zh: : 我不擅长万圣节……

lines.en: scene black
: Excuse me!
lines.zh: : 打扰一下！

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar36
: Ah! Customerburger!
lines.zh: : 啊！顾客汉堡！

lines.en: : I like your butterfly!
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你的蝴蝶！

lines.en: : Did you know that the average lifespan for the red admiral butterfly is approximately ten months?!
lines.zh: : 你知道红蛱蝶的平均寿命大约是十个月吗？！

lines.en: : Kaori, what did I tell you about giving insect facts to the customers {i}before{/i} taking their orders?
lines.zh: : Kaori，我是怎么跟你说的，在点单{i}之前{/i}别给客人科普昆虫知识？

lines.en: : Noooooo tell me more butterfly facts. I wanna know!
lines.zh: : 不————告诉我更多蝴蝶知识。我想知道！

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar37
: Then...did you know there are over 24,000 species?! And that some of them can fly up to 12 miles per hour?!
lines.zh: : 那么……你知道蝴蝶有两万四千多种吗？！还有有些能飞到每小时 12 英里？！

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar38
: Ahh, yeah. That’s the stuff.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。就是这个。

lines.en: : Inject that lepidopterology right into my veins, baby.
lines.zh: : 把这鳞翅目学直接注射进我的血管里吧，宝贝。

lines.en: : Uhh...she botherin’ you? Cause if you’ve got somethin’ you wanna order-
lines.zh: : 呃……她烦到你了吗？要是你想点什么——

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar39
: Not at all! I’ll take three of whatever your favorite thing on the menu is.
lines.zh: : 一点都不！菜单上你最喜欢的东西给我来三份。

lines.en: : Aight. Three beers. Got it.
lines.zh: : 好嘞。三杯啤酒。明白。

lines.en: : Yuki, come on! Upsell! Profits! Business lingo!
lines.zh: : Yuki，拜托！加钱！利润！商业术语！

lines.en: : What? She asked for my favorite thing on the menu.
lines.zh: : 怎么？是她问我最喜欢菜单上什么的。

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar40
: You are very pretty, Miss. Are you really having such trouble fornicating that you had to come here?
lines.zh: : 你很漂亮，小姐。你是真的在交媾上遇到麻烦，才不得不来这儿的吗？

lines.en: : Woah. The flier said “Halloween Party,” but I didn’t realize that’s the sorta thing I was getting myself into.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。传单上写的是“万圣节派对”，我可没想到我要参加的会是这种。

lines.en: : Do you hit on everyone with butterfly related trivia or am I just lucky?
lines.zh: : 你是跟所有人都用蝴蝶相关的冷知识搭讪，还是只有我这么幸运？

lines.en: scene halloweentwobar41
: Hitting {i}on!{/i} I know what that means now!
lines.zh: : {i}搭讪{/i}！我现在知道那是什么意思了！

lines.en: : Hahahah! I love this place already!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！我已经爱上这个地方了！

lines.en: scene black
